tasks.short: Study and interpret religious laws and doctrines

steps.what: Study the religious laws, doctrines, or traditions this question names.
Decide how those doctrines bear on this member's case.
Interpret those doctrines aloud for the member who asked.

tasks.design: She studies the religious laws, doctrines, or traditions in {DOCS}, decides what they mean for this member, and interprets that aloud. The interpretation is spoken and is not filed. The design does not draft a reading, send a message, or raise an alert.
tasks.previous_blocker: The meaning depends on this member's case. A text search cannot carry that.
tasks.enabler_now: The tradition texts are already in {DOCS}. No new tool is added.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong interpretation can harm the member who relies on it.
tasks.human_edge: She holds the tradition and the person in one judgement.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still studies the texts, decides the reading, and interprets it aloud for the member.

reach.task: Choose what a class may teach from the tradition
reach.learn: Which reading she will not hand to a generated text.

evidence.claim: EU AI Act article 4 requires AI literacy for any AI use. Annex III point 3 covers admission to, or grading students in, an educational institution.
Interpreting a doctrine for a member is the clergy person's own judgement, and a mid-size congregation does not hand that reading to a model.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The passages are tradition texts already held in {DOCS}. She chooses them herself. No model drafts a reading, so there is no draft to check and no release to gate.
The member is not on staff. The interpretation is live speech. No written ruling is filed or sent, so there is no commit or send to gate.
This task does not grade students or decide admission to an educational institution. No AI system is added, so AI-literacy duties are not triggered here.
unknowns: Whether this tradition requires a written ruling after the spoken interpretation.
Whether the person who asked is an employee of the church body rather than a member.
research_questions: Does this denomination require the interpretation to be written down?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a question where she studies the named passages, decides the reading, and interprets it aloud for the member, no step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Respond to requests in emergencies or crises

steps.what: Hear requests for assistance during the emergency visit.
Decide what assistance these emergencies or crises need.
Respond in person to the member or family who asked.

tasks.design: She hears the request for assistance, decides what this emergency or crisis needs, and responds in person to the member or family. Nothing is filed or sent. The design does not raise an alert or send a message.
tasks.previous_blocker: The need is known only from the person in front of her. A rule cannot see it.
tasks.enabler_now: She already goes in person. No new tool is added.
tasks.still_hard: A delayed or wrong response can harm the person in the crisis.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what this person needs and stays with them.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still hears the request, decides the assistance, and responds in person.

reach.task: Go to a client who has asked for help in a crisis
reach.learn: The response is the visit, not a message sent ahead of it.

evidence.claim: In a mid-size congregation the clergy person responds to a crisis by going to the member or the family, and does not send that response as a message.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The person in the emergency is a member or their family, outside the staff. She hears the request and responds in person. The response is live speech and presence.
No note is filed and no message is sent, so there is no commit or send to gate. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether the request comes from emergency services rather than from the member or family.
Whether a written pastoral note is required after the visit.
research_questions: Who is allowed to call her out during an emergency?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a crisis where she hears the request, decides the assistance, and responds in person, no step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Hear how weddings, funerals, or confirmations should be held.
Decide the form of these special ceremonies.
Conduct the rite for this wedding, funeral, or confirmation.

tasks.design: She hears what the family needs for the wedding, funeral, or confirmation, decides the form of the special ceremony, and conducts the rite in person. No order of service is filed or emailed. The design does not generate a script or send an invitation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The rite is the gathering. A text cannot stand in for her presence.
tasks.enabler_now: She already conducts the rite in person. No new tool is added.
tasks.still_hard: A missed name or a wrong form is public and cannot be undone in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She conducts the rite the family and the tradition both require.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still hears the family, decides the form, and conducts the rite.

reach.task: Prepare a couple for a wedding conversation
reach.learn: The rite itself stays with the person who was asked to conduct it.

evidence.claim: In a mid-size congregation the clergy person conducts weddings, funerals, and confirmations in person with the family present.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The people at the wedding, funeral, or confirmation are members, family, or guests, outside the staff. She conducts the rite in person.
No order of service is filed or emailed, and no invitation is sent, so there is no commit or send to gate. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether a civil registration sits inside this task or with another office.
Whether the family expects a written order of service to be kept.
research_questions: Does this denomination file the ceremony anywhere after it is conducted?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a funeral where she hears the family, decides the form, and conducts the rite, no step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.short: Devise ways to expand congregational membership

steps.what: Read which congregational membership moves the register holds.
Devise ways congregational membership can be expanded.
Tell the church council the ways she has devised.

tasks.design: She reads membership moves in the {OTHER} member register, devises ways congregational membership can be expanded, and tells the church council. She does not export the list or send a mailing. The design does not raise an alert.
tasks.previous_blocker: A missing line can mean the person was never registered. A count cannot tell her which.
tasks.enabler_now: The member register already holds the moves she reads. No new tool is added.
tasks.still_hard: Membership reveals religious belief, and a wrong appeal can disclose it.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which move is a real change and which gap is a missing registration.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the moves, devises the ways, and tells the church council.

reach.task: Judge why a local group grew or shrank
reach.learn: A missing register line is not by itself a departure.

evidence.claim: Membership of a church reveals religious belief, a special category. Article 9(2)(d) allows a religious not-for-profit body to process it for members and regular contacts, but not to disclose it outside the body without consent.
The Roermond diocese reports gaps in the shared register, mainly young Catholics, because some Limburg parishes do not register new members.
Catholics can have the municipal population link removed.
Devising how a congregation grows stays with the clergy person, and a mid-size body does not send a membership appeal from a model.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

The member register is the {OTHER} record the church secretary already keeps. The fields she reads are the person's name, join date, leave date, and whether the municipal link is still on. The secretary maintains those fields. Municipal moves arrive only where the person did not object. If a join date or a leave date is missing she asks the secretary and does not treat the gap as a join or a leave. A missing young member can mean the person was never registered. A removed municipal link is not a departure. The reading is this first step and is not treated as free. No machine step uses the fields.

The church council are colleagues. She tells them the ways in person and does not read the list out to anyone outside the body. No mailing is sent and nothing is filed, so there is no commit or send to gate.
unknowns: Whether every council member is an employee, or some are volunteers.
Whether a later task, not this one, sends the membership appeal.
research_questions: Who besides the church secretary may correct a join date or a leave date?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a year where she reads the membership moves, devises ways to expand, and tells the church council, no step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still studies doctrine, responds in a crisis, conducts the rite, and devises membership ways. Nothing is handed off.
reach: A director of religious education learns which doctrine reading she will not hand to a generated text.
A community health worker learns that a missing membership line is not by itself a departure.
skills_to_grow: Judge a doctrine question from the texts and the member, not from a generated reading.
Go to the person in a crisis rather than sending a message.
Read a membership gap as a possible missing registration.
role.ambitious_version: The same clergy person still studies, responds, conducts, and devises. No interpretation, crisis reply, rite, or membership appeal is sent in her place.
